= 0.217 [0.175, 0.260]).", "-    </p>", "-  </div>", "+<h3>Mechanism</h3>", "+<p>", "+The consensus signal", "+<a class=\"code-ref\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/main/round-3/evaluation-2\">[code]</a>", "+decomposes into two components: <strong>endorsement</strong> <var>e</var> (fraction of ERROR items", "+endorsed by the peer majority) and <strong>divergence</strong> <var>d</var> (fraction of CORRECT items", "+that diverge from peers). The scatter index (ratio of pairwise disagreement among correct vs. error", "+items per sentence) is 4.45 [3.57, 5.77]: error translations are far more diverse than correct ones.", "+</p>", " ", "-  <div class=\"result-row\">", "-    <h3>The rename tradeoff</h3>", "-    <p>", "-      <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/main/round-3/experiment-8\">Rename code</a>.", "-      c_score_align has a NONCE rename false-alarm rate of 0.765 (flip rate 0.605).", "-      The name-free variant c_nf eliminates rename sensitivity (flip = 0) but is blind to meaning-rename errors (within-base AUROC 0.499, chance) and has lower overall discrimination (strat AUROC 0.686 vs. 0.741).", "-      Every vocabulary bridge that lowers divergence <var>d</var> raises endorsement <var>e</var>: the aligner lowers <var>d</var> from 0.583 to 0.328 but raises meaning-rename endorsement from 0.104 to 0.624.", "-    </p>", "-  </div>", "+<p>", "+The net consensus degradation from short to long sentences is &Delta;(e+d) = +0.356 [+0.198, +0.493],", "+driven almost entirely by divergence (&Delta;d = +0.608, &Delta;e = &minus;0.252). Correct", "+translations of long sentences increasingly disagree with peers because independent models make", "+different structural choices for complex quantifier scopes and exception clauses.", "+</p>", " ", "-  <div class=\"result-row\">", "-    <h3>Per-type sensitivity</h3>", "-    <p>", "-      On the PERTURB suite (4,234 typed mutants + 868 controls), consensus recall at the primary threshold is flat across error operators: NEG 0.761, SWAP 0.758, DROP 0.721, ADD 0.763, MEANING_RENAME 0.762.", "-      <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/main/round-2/dataset-3\">PERTURB suite code</a>.", "-    </p>", "-  </div>", "+<p>", "+Three peer families suffice for 97% of the full-pool AUROC (k<sub>95</sub> = 3), but the", "+long-sentence tercile requires k<sub>95</sub> = 5.", "+</p>", "+</div>", " ", "-  <div class=\"result-row\">", "-    <h3>Dead ends</h3>", "-    <p>", "-      Several alternatives were abandoned: a fused structural-feature filter (false-alarm gate failure);", "-      name-free consensus c_nf (rename-invariant but blind to meaning-rename errors);", "-      a decomposed solver-based semantic reader (balanced accuracy 0.476);", "-      LLM adjudication of disputed items (balanced accuracy 0.662);", "-      and <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/main/round-4/experiment-9\">candidate-signature consensus</a>, which cued peers with the candidate's own predicate symbols (error endorsement rose to 0.459 from anchoring).", "-      The <a href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-eff060-layered-gold-free-checks-for-logic/tree/main/round-5/experiment-14\">Gloss-Gated checker</a> failed its development gate (strat AUROC 0.696 vs. V0 0.742).", "-    </p>", "-  </div>", "+<div class=\"table-wrap\">", "+<table>", "+<caption>Table 2. The confirmation attempt produced no testable positive cell.</li>", "-    <li><strong>Rename vulnerability.</strong> A 76.5% false-alarm rate on nonce renames means the metric will systematically penalise any translation that uses non-standard predicate names, even if semantically correct.</li>", "-    <li><strong>Length degradation.</strong> Consensus discrimination degrades with sentence length (NET +0.356), driven by correct-translation divergence.     prev = level
```
"
```

```
File: /ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_u75jRHUss0zo/4_gen_paper_repo/_4_assemble_paper/paper/README.md

# Gold-Free Faithfulness Metrics for NL-to-FOL Translation

Public page for the paper *Cross-Family Solver Consensus as a Gold-Free
Faithfulness Metric for Natural-Language-to-First-Order-Logic Translation:
A Preliminary Study*.

## Overview

Evaluating whether an LLM-generated first-order logic (FOL) formula
faithfully captures the meaning of a natural-language sentence is hard
without gold-standard FOL annotations. This paper proposes **cross-family
solver consensus**: multiple independent translation systems each produce a
FOL candidate, and an SMT solver checks pairwise equivalence. A sentence
whose translations all agree is likely correct; one where they disagree
flags a probable error. The resulting metric, *stratified AUROC*, reaches
0.741 without any human-written FOL.

## Repository contents

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Self-contained project page (inline CSS/JS, no external dependencies) |
| `paper.tex` | LaTeX source of the paper |
| `paper.pdf` | Compiled PDF |
| `figures/` | PNG figures used on the project page |
| `references.bib` | BibTeX bibliography |

## Viewing the page

Open `index.html` in any modern browser, or visit the GitHub Pages deployment.
No build step or server is required.

## License

See the paper for terms.
```

````
# Gold-Free Faithfulness Metrics for NL-to-FOL Translation

Public project page for the paper *Cross-Family Solver Consensus as a
Gold-Free Faithfulness Metric for Natural-Language-to-First-Order-Logic
Translation: A Preliminary Study*.

## What this is

A single self-contained HTML page that presents the paper's contributions,
method, results, and figures faster than reading the PDF. It is designed to
be served directly from GitHub Pages with no build step.

## Repository layout

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Self-contained project page (inline CSS/JS, no external deps) |
| `paper.tex` | LaTeX source of the paper |
| `references.bib` | BibTeX bibliography |
| `references.json` | Structured bibliography in JSON |
| `figures/*.png` | Rendered figures used by the project page |
| `figures/*_spec.json` | Figure generation specs |

## Viewing the page

Open `index.html` in any modern browser, or visit the GitHub Pages deployment.
No build step, server, or external resources are required.

## Restoring removed files

The following files were removed to reduce repository size. Each can be
regenerated from the sources that remain in the repository.

**Compiled PDF** (`paper.pdf`):
```bash
pdflatex paper.tex && bibtex paper && pdflatex paper.tex && pdflatex paper.tex
```

**LaTeX workspace** (`workspace/`):
```bash
pdflatex paper.tex && bibtex paper && pdflatex paper.tex && pdflatex paper.tex
```

**Vector figure PDFs** (`figures/fig_dev_auroc_v0.pdf`, `figures/fig_complexity_v0.pdf`, `figures/fig_k_curve_v0.pdf`):
```bash
python workspace render using figures/fig_dev_auroc_spec.json
python workspace render using figures/fig_complexity_spec.json
python workspace render using figures/fig_k_curve_spec.json
```

## License

See the paper for terms.
````

```
# Gold-Free Faithfulness Metrics for NL-to-FOL Translation

Public project page for the paper *Cross-Family Solver Consensus as a
Gold-Free Faithfulness Metric for Natural-Language-to-First-Order-Logic
Translation: A Preliminary Study*.

## What this is

A single self-contained HTML page that presents the paper's contributions,
method, results, and figures faster than reading the PDF. It is designed to
be served directly from GitHub Pages with no build step.

## Repository layout

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Self-contained project page (inline CSS/JS, no external deps) |
| `paper.tex` | LaTeX source of the paper |
| `paper.pdf` | Compiled PDF of the paper |
| `references.bib` | BibTeX bibliography |
| `references.json` | Structured bibliography in JSON |
| `figures/*.png` | Rendered figures used by the project page |
| `figures/*.pdf` | Vector figure originals |
| `figures/*_spec.json` | Figure generation specs |

## Viewing the page

Open `index.html` in any modern browser, or visit the GitHub Pages deployment.
No build step, server, or external resources are required.

## License

See the paper for terms.
```
